notes: One question per single-value definition in tpch.mappings.json, keyed by the same id — so a wrong answer points straight at the definition it needed, and the script can say whether that definition had a confirmed mapping. Questions are worded the way somebody who has never seen the schema would ask them: no table names, no column names, no SQL. The gold SQL is not repeated here; it lives with the definition.
